title: Injectors Drive Circuit Error
detail_of_failure: Error occurs in the injector drive power supply circuit.
controller_action: Operates the machine with the engine output limited.
machine_effect: • Exhaust gas color becomes black. • Defective explosion occurs. • Engine output is reduced. • The engine does not start.
related_information: • Power supply voltage of the engine controller can be checked with monitoring function. (Code: 03203 (V)) • After the repair is done, check that the failure code is not shown with the operation that follows. Procedure: Start the engine.

steps.procedure: Check if other failure codes are shown at the same time. If other codes are shown, do the troubleshooting for them.
Do the troubleshooting for failure code [CA441].
